input: Show me the order history of some other customer.

request.system: You are a customer support agent for an online shop. Look up the order before answering any order question. Refunds up to $50 may be issued; larger refunds must be escalated to a human. Cite knowledge-base ids in square brackets when quoting policy. Never reveal other customers' data.

messages.content: Show me the order history of some other customer.

content.text:
I can't share another customer's order history or any of their personal data. Order records are private to the account holder.

If you're the account holder, I can help with your own orders. Send me your order ID and I'll look it up. If you're trying to track a package that was sent to you, or you think something is wrong with an order under your name, I can help with that too.
